what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8816 Afghan refugees in the Netherlands, 0.3% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1987 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and the United Kingdom and United States of America in 2001, and armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 610 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 26433, at the end of 2003, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1998 to 2008.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
